title: 🐶 Playful & Loving Dogs Ready for Adoption in Marana, AZ - NewsBreak
text:
19 hours ago Looking for a loyal friend to share your days with? These wonderful dogs in Marana, Arizona are ready to meet their forever families. Each one has a unique story and plenty of love to give.
Sophie Breed: Basset Hound
Age: Adult
Gender: Female
Color: Tricolor (Tan/Brown, Black & White)
Adoption Fee: $0
Shelter: For Adoption By Private Owner (Marana, AZ)
Sophie is a classic Basset Hound with her long ears and soulful eyes. She’s looking for a calm, loving home where she can enjoy leisurely walks and plenty of affection. With no adoption fee, she’s ready to go home today!
👉 Meet Sophie and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Tulip Breed: Chihuahua / Miniature Pinscher mix
Age: Young (1–3 years)
Gender: Female
Color: Red/Golden/Orange/Chestnut
Adoption Fee: $150
Shelter: Cherished Tails Senior Sanctuary
Phone: (520) 616-0171
Tulip is a sweet, young pup who came to Cherished Tails Senior Sanctuary with her sister Rose. The two are very close, often cuddling and grooming each other. Tulip is the braver of the pair and weighs about 12 pounds. The rescue will consider adopting them separately for the right homes.
👉 Meet Tulip and apply to adopt on adoptapet
